verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Slack serves an official llms.txt at docs.slack.dev/llms.txt (HTTP 200, titled 'Slack Developer Docs'). The pack also shows an llms-full-deno.txt variant and Markdown (.md) versions of doc pages such as quickstart.md, block-kit.md and build-with-ai.md, so agents can consume the docs directly. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents using these files in practice, and evidence of how complete the llms.txt index is across the full doc set.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
